file_reviews.assessment: Complete source read of the package Demo 3 host engine. Assesses atomic batch transaction execution: pre-decrement fuel accounting, snapshot-based rollback of covered elements, witness candidate, and phase upon batch refusal, hash-chained receipts, and terminal transition on fuel exhaustion.

Full source inspection of Demo 3 host test suite. Confirms test_poisoned_batch_rolls_covered_elements_back, test_move_after_verify_rolls_the_whole_batch_back, test_empty_batch_consumes_fuel_and_rolls_back, and test_repeated_refusals_consume_fuel_and_exhaust asserting charge-then-rollback.
Full source inspection of Paper 003 manuscript. Section 4 and Section 4.1 specify the host state machine, fuel consumption, atomic rollback, and differences between baseline and package hosts.
Claim ledger row P3-01 specifies that the host charges one fuel unit before applying each batch, restores semantic state on refusal, and does not return fuel.
Source inspection of repository Demo3HostEngine adapter. Confirms line 285 remaining_fuel -= 1, lines 326-329 state snapshot, and lines 390-394 semantic rollback on failure with unrefunded fuel.

claims.statement: The Demo 3 host decrements remaining fuel by one before processing each batch, restores semantic state (covered elements, witness candidate, and phase) on batch refusal, and retains the fuel decrement.
dependencies: Demo 3 host engine state machine initialized with positive integer fuel in a non-terminal phase.
Batch processing executes with pre-decrement fuel accounting and snapshot-based atomic semantic rollback.
claims.limits: Applies strictly to processed batches in the declared host state machine; fuel bounds only charged batch attempts, not total HTTP requests, uncharged calls, input bytes, or host execution time.
